scope: Derived only in the browser test from the exact 079 reviewed comparator target. It removes the region mapping and its region-specific review/crop projections to exercise pending fail-closed owner, copy, reload and history behavior. It does not alter the product data or claim that the current comparator is unmapped.

derivation.purpose: Exercise the pending-field safety path using an explicitly derived in-memory copy while the actual six current comparator targets remain resolved and are tested separately.

expectedSafetyBehavior.unmappedOwnerQuery: Do not substitute the comparator item or claim the field is resolved; retain a pending target with no region.
expectedSafetyBehavior.canonicalOwnerCopy: Copy the exact field pointer and source owner; displaying the comparator item is allowed only after that owner is explicit.
expectedSafetyBehavior.reloadAndHistory: Keep the pending label, owner identity, exact source page, and no-region state through reload and Back/Forward.
